name: Drowned Domain
description: Pull a nearby hostile mob into a separate island dimension for 40 seconds. You begin inside a large two-block-deep lagoon while the target starts on a sandy crescent, forcing it to chase your superior swimming or endure the barrage. After five seconds, fast cannonballs fire inward from the four ship-facing walls every half-second. Their damage is 55% of your current attack damage, plus 1.5 per completed 10% Curse. You gain 50% movement speed, powerful swimming, Regeneration II and 50% lifesteal while inside.
